title: Horse Call
description: Use a goat horn to locate your mount from up to 160 blocks away.
body:
# ![Reveal Mount Header](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bbc940681ed0f4f2890e14f6ba5e462b73bff245_0.webp)

When using a goat horn of any variant, the nearest saddled mount will **reveal their location** by making a sound and glowing for a few seconds.

This data pack **prioritizes owned mounts** (e.g., horses, mules). If an owned mount cannot be found it looks for tamed mounts (e.g., camels, skeleton horses). If a tamed mount cannot be found it looks for stick-led mounts (e.g., pigs, striders). If a saddled mount still cannot be found, the goat horn acts as usual.

The search for a saddled mount reaches out **160 blocks** from the player. This is around where the glow effect drops off. If the player is standing too close to their mount it will look for the next closest saddled mount, making the assumption that the player knows where the one they're standing next to is.

## Support
I do not have plans to backport Horse Call. If you have issues with the data pack, contact me through Discord (`1cale`) or create a new issue on GitHub.

## Credit
Horse Call is an extended version of Horse Trumpet made by [misterk7_-](https://modrinth.com/user/misterk7_-). I originally planned on just updating it for personal use, but I ended up making it look for more than just horses, so here I am.
